remarks: Discover the Metro Align 18 by Cantiro Homes, thoughtfully designed to offer flexible living spaces and modern functionality. The rear kitchen features stainless steel appliances and overlooks the backyard, flowing seamlessly into the open-concept dining and living areas to create an inviting space for everyday living and entertaining. A main-floor bedroom and full bathroom provide added flexibility for guests or a home office. Upstairs, you'll find three additional bedrooms, including a spacious primary bedroom with a walk-in closet and 4-piece ensuite, along with a centrally located bonus room perfect for movie nights or family relaxation. Additional features include a Linen interior style, SEPERATE SIDE ENTRANCE, rough-in drains, 9' foundation, and elegant iron spindle railing. Photos are for representation only. Features, finishes, and colours may vary. (id:67522)
